name: 21st Century Plastics Corp.
old_description: 21st CPC quality management system has been certified to ISO based standards since 1997
about:
21st Century Plastics Corp. operates from Potterville, Michigan, where it was founded in 1997. The company transitioned to 100 percent employee ownership in 2010 and has maintained an ISO-certified quality management system since its inception, achieving ISO 9001:2015 certification.

The facility houses 15 injection molding machines ranging from 55 to 1,500 tons, featuring high-pressure injection, closed-loop process control, and automatic mold data storage. Two table-travel CNC vertical mills machine steel, aluminum, and plastic, while an Airwolf 3D Axiom printer produces fixtures and verification equipment in over 40 materials. Secondary capabilities include spin welding, painting, surface grinding, manual machining, and offline assembly.

The company serves customers requiring custom molded components, precision machined parts, and 3D-printed tooling, though specific industry sectors are not publicly listed.

Employee ownership and a stated emphasis on personal service distinguish the operation; the company highlights its niche in customer service and deep expertise in molding.
